title.narrative: Mujeres indígenas y campesinas rurales, fortalecidas en su autonomía

description.narrative:
The project seeks to strengthen the political, social and economic autonomy of indigenous, peasant and rural women who face multiple forms of violence associated with socio-environmental conflicts caused by extractive companies and monocultures. In the face of the destruction of livelihoods and the violation of human rights, the project proposes to implement strategic actions that promote the active participation of women in community, municipal, regional and national spaces where decisions are made about their territories and their lives.
The initiative focuses on the development of women's political and technical capacities, the strengthening of community leadership, and the inclusion of young people and girls in training and awareness-raising processes. It also promotes advocacy with state institutions to guarantee women's rights and the protection of their territories.
